html:
SMTO-AUT-0030 — Your Google account needs extra permission for this

GUID: 4f39c6b0-a8cc-5ea3-a200-c725de8e3ea9
Slug: google-scope-upgrade-required
Domain: AUT · Subsystem: google-workspace

What happened

  • Your Google account is connected, but you haven't yet allowed SMTO to use it for this kind of work, such as sending email or changing calendar events. SMTO stopped before doing anything.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO to add the access this request needs to the Google account it already uses. SMTO then asks Google only for what's missing and keeps the same account and Google app setup.
  2. Open the Google link SMTO gives you, check that you're signing in with the same email address, and read the list of access Google shows. Google marks some access, like full mailbox or Drive access, as sensitive, so you should know what you're approving.
  3. Approve the new access, wait for the page to say you're connected, then send your request again. SMTO checks the account's access each time and will now find the new permission.

What success looks like

  • Your request runs without asking for more Google access.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send it to the person who manages SMTO. Don't connect a different Google account to get around this; SMTO would then act as that account.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The Google account's saved provider-granted scopes do not satisfy one or more features required by the requested Workspace operation.

What this means

  • The saved provider-granted scope set does not satisfy one or more requested Workspace features. Authorization establishes a particular connection, account and scope. It neither expands operation permissions nor proves the outcome of a request already dispatched.

Why this can happen

  • The saved provider-granted scope set does not satisfy one or more requested Workspace features.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare missing_features with the saved granted scopes and the requested operation.

How to fix it

  • Read missing_features, required_scopes, account_ref and oauth_app_ref from the error details, then run auth.google_connect with the same auth_app_ref and account_key and those missing features. Review the returned scope classifications (sensitive or restricted scopes may need Google verification) before consent; no scope is upgraded automatically.
  • Use auth.google_connect with the same OAuth app and account_key and the reported missing_features. Review scope classifications before consent.

Retry and execution caution

  • Confirm account identity and required features before retrying.

How to verify the fix

  • The same intended account has the minimum scopes required for the selected features.

What not to do

  • Do not expose client secrets, tokens, codes or PKCE verifiers.
  • Do not switch accounts or repeat uncertain mutations automatically.

Technical notes

  • Authorization establishes a particular connection, account and scope. It neither expands operation permissions nor proves the outcome of a request already dispatched.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
